glosses: material (matter from which physical things are made or which is otherwise used to create such things)
material (something, as data or an idea, that may be reworked into a new form or may serve as the basis for interpretations)

examples.text: Я хочу костюм из этого материала.
examples.en: I want a suit made of this material.

examples.text: Этот портной всегда использует очень хорошие материалы.
examples.en: That tailor always uses very good material.
